spearheads.name: Darkoath Raiders
spearheads.text:
The title of Darkoath Warqueen is conferred only upon those women who unite and lead multiple tribes. Yet even rising to such dizzying heights is not enough, for such power is only the first step upon the Path to Glory in the eyes of the Ruinous Powers. Thus, these leaders must continually swear greater oaths and undertake increasingly dangerous acts of violence and conquest. Where discretion is required to gain advantageous territory, a Warqueen will set out with only her most elite and trusted fighters to bring her strategies to fruition. These raiding parties are large enough to take down rival detachments or monstrous fauna whilst remaining quick and agile.
Canny Warqueens will always include those ferocious fighters known as Savagers within their retinue. Whilst still mortal, these warriors are zealous in their violence and will continue to fight until their last breath. The Godspeakers accompanying them are vital for advising and directing their queen with cryptic prophecies and potent prayers. Accompanying these elites will come the Warqueen’s closest kin: Marauders bedecked in their oathstones and sworn to defend their leader to the last. Whilst most march with the Warqueen on foot, a small number will travel mounted to scout ahead. These Fellriders are crucial for providing ranged cover should foes set upon the raiding party from afar.

battle_traits.name: OATHS OF DARKNESS
battle_traits.effect:
You can reveal 1 battle tactic card in your hand to your opponent. If you do so, that battle tactic card becomes your oath for the rest of the turn.
While this battle tactic card is your oath, you can still use the command on it, or attempt to score the battle tactic on it, as normal.
If you score the battle tactic on your oath this turn, your oath is fulfilled. Instead of discarding the card, it is placed to one side but you can still use the command on it. Once you do so, the card is discarded as normal. Fulfilled oaths placed to one side in this way do not count towards the 3 battle tactic cards you can have in your hand.
If you use the command on your oath before it is scored, it is discarded as normal. At the end of the turn, if the oath is still in your hand and that oath has not been fulfilled, it ceases to be your oath.

regiment_abilities.name: RAGE OF ARKHAR
regiment_abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit in combat to be the target.
regiment_abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic and the Rend characteristic of the target’s melee weapons.

options.name: Designer’s Note
options.text: This does not affect Companion weapons.

regiment_abilities.name: FEARLESS INVADERS
regiment_abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit in combat to be the target.
regiment_abilities.effect: If the target uses a RETREAT ability this turn, no mortal damage is inflicted on it and it can still use CHARGE abilities later in the turn.

enhancements.name: BLOODTHIRSTY BLADE
enhancements.effect: The Rend characteristic of your general’s Rune-etched Axe is 2.

enhancements.name: CHAMPION OF RAIDS
enhancements.declare: Pick another friendly unit wholly within 12" of your general to be the target.
enhancements.effect: The target can re-roll charge rolls for the rest of the turn.

enhancements.name: FELL RITUALIST
enhancements.effect: Each time you draw battle tactic cards, if your general is on the battlefield, you can choose to draw 1 additional battle tactic card, then put 1 of your battle tactic cards in your hand back at the bottom of your battle tactic deck.

abilities.name: OATH OF SUPREMACY
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 12" of your general to be the target.
abilities.effect: Until the start of your next turn, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by the target.

abilities.name: SWIFT ATTACKERS
abilities.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit.

warscrolls.name: Darkoath Savagers

abilities.name: VISIONS OF GLORY
abilities.effect: If this unit includes a Godspeaker, roll 8 dice. For each 4+, until the start of your next turn, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, 1 wound roll, 1 run roll or 1 save roll for this unit.

warscrolls.composition: 1 model in this unit is a Godspeaker.

abilities.name: GLORIOUS DEATH
abilities.effect: Each time a model in this unit is slain by a combat attack and that model was in combat with the attacking model, roll a dice. On a 5+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the attacking unit after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.

spearheads.name: Bloodwind Legion
spearheads.text:
When a worshipper of the Dark Gods has walked the Path to Glory, conquering lands and slaughtering their rivals, they will eventually reach the final obstacle that lies before their ascension to daemonhood. Such a fell blessing requires dedication tenfold compared to what hardships came before, and only feats of the most spectacular violence can hope to catch the Dark Pantheon’s eyes. Thus will a newly crowned Chaos Lord strike out in order to seek the bloodiest battles and raise their own despoiling armies.
Such cursed ranks can be spotted marauding across the realms with their Chaos Lord at their head. With the Ruinous Powers watching their every move, the Lord will cleave through front lines with their reaperblade, receiving bounteous blessings in exchange. The fighters that accompany this champion are equal parts their soldiers and rivals, hoping to steal glory for themselves. Alongside Chaos Warriors thunder Chaos Knights, towering warriors atop gore-streaked steeds that shatter enemy formations with the power of their charge. Should numerically superior foes seek to overwhelm these elites, a rumbling Chaos Chariot will come to the fore. This heavy war-carriage can bowl over and crush entire rows of infantry once it gathers momentum, even as its riders lay about themselves with lash and spiked flail.

battle_traits.name: DREADED ARRIVAL
battle_traits.effect: Set up this unit wholly within your territory, within 1" of a battlefield edge and more than 6" from all enemy units.
battle_traits.text: Your Chaos Knights unit is not set up during the deployment phase. Instead, from the second battle round onwards, they can use the Dreaded Arrival ability

battle_traits.name: EYE OF THE GODS
battle_traits.declare:
Pick one of the following friendly units to use this ability:
A unit that is contesting an objective not controlled by your opponent and is not in combat. A unit that destroyed an enemy unit this turn.
battle_traits.effect:
Roll once on the Eye of the Gods table for that unit. That unit gains the Eye of the Gods passive ability that corresponds to the roll (the unit keeps all Eye of the Gods abilities gained in previous turns). If the same unit gains the same ability more than once in the battle, the effects are not cumulative.
D6 ABILITY 1 Snubbed by the Gods: No effect. 2 WARD OF TZEENTCH: This unit has WARD (6+). 3 GRACE OF SLAANESH: Add 1 to run rolls for this unit. 4 BLESSING OF NURGLE: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target this unit. 5 FURY OF KHORNE: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons. 6 Champion of Chaos: Pick any ability from the table.

regiment_abilities.name: FIERCE CONQUERORS
regiment_abilities.effect: Add 3 to the control scores of friendly Chaos Warriors units.

regiment_abilities.name: THE DREAD BANNER
regiment_abilities.timing: Start of the First Battle Round
regiment_abilities.declare: Pick a friendly Chaos Warriors unit.
regiment_abilities.effect: You can immediately roll on the Eye of the Gods table for that unit.

enhancements.name: MARK OF KHORNE
enhancements.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of your general’s melee weapons if they charged in the same turn.

enhancements.name: MARK OF NURGLE
enhancements.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for combat attacks that target your general.

enhancements.name: MARK OF TZEENTCH
enhancements.declare: Pick a friendly unit on the battlefield. You cannot pick your general.
enhancements.effect: Remove that unit from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 6" of your general and more than 6" from all enemy units. It cannot use Move abilities for the rest of the phase.

abilities.name: FAVOURED OF THE PANTHEON
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, you can roll on the Eye of the Gods table for this unit.

abilities.name: IRON-WILLED CHAMPION
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target and roll a dice. You cannot pick this unit.
abilities.effect: On a 2+, add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by the target unit this phase.

abilities.name: SWIFT DEATH
abilities.declare: If this unit charged this phase, pick an enemy unit within 1" of it to be the target and roll a dice.
abilities.effect: On a 2+, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

abilities.name: BRINGERS OF DESOLATION
abilities.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by this unit that target an enemy unit that is contesting an objective you do not control.

abilities.name: IMPALING CHARGE
abilities.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit’s Cursed Lances if it charged in the same turn.
